name: diagram-design
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：diagram-design。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Create branded architecture, IT current-state, flowchart, sequence, state machine, ER/data model, timeline, swimlane, quadrant, radar/spider, loop/flywheel, nested, tree, org chart, layer stack, Venn, pyramid/funnel, treemap, bar, line, Gantt and scatter charts, high-level, process, medallion, data flow, DP integration, DP security matrix, Sankey, fishbone, Wardley map, kanban, user journey, deplo
unshelve_reason: 问二 · 23,486 星的画图大路货，任何目录站和「必装清单」里都有，收它用户拿不到增量——这正是 D40 按问二下架 ★6958 那件 Cocoon-AI 的同一条线。在架已有四件画图件（自动选型 / Tufte 品味标准 / 可编辑 .excalidraw / 架构专精），它是这四件的并集而不是新角度。且正文主场景是企业现代化提案（IT 现状图、DP 安全矩阵、客户品牌 profile），按新方向是「为工作装」。 正文原话：正文 §3 类型表：「Legacy IT landscape grouped by phase/department; documents the *before* state in modernization proposals」；§0 首次运行门：「Don't silently ship default-skinned diagrams into a branded project.」
